author: KEXP
description: Norwegian powerhouse Slomosa bring thundering energy and raw power to the KEXP Live Room in our latest in-studio session. With host Troy Neson, the band shares a performance of "Battling Guns" and more.
title: Slomosa performs "Battling Guns" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG presents Slomosa performing live in the KEXP studio. Recorded April 15, 2026.

Songs:  
Afghansk Rev
Cabin Fever
In My Mind’s Desert
Battling Guns
Horses

Ben Berdous - Guitar, Vocals
Tor Erik Bye - Guitar
Marie Moe - Bass, Vocals
Jard Hole - Drums

Host: Troy Nelson

Guest Audio Engineer: Jon Anders Orlein
Mastering Engineer: Julian Martlew
